title: B2-02 · Advanced syntax: long periods, chains of iḍāfa, relative without pronoun

blocks.text: B2-02 · Advanced syntax: long periods, chains of iḍāfa,
relative without pronoun
Lesson overview

In B2-01 you have learned to find the dorsal spine of a long period. Now unmount the pieces that surround it: the chains of iḍāfa ( ⁧رَئِيسُ مَجْلِسِ إِدَارَةِ الشَّرِكَةِ⁩ ), adjectives referring to a distant element of the chain, descriptive phrases without relative pronoun ( ⁧مَشْرُوعًا يَهْدِفُ إِلَى⁩ ...), the parties acting as relative ( ⁧الدُّوَلُ المُشَارِكَةُ فِي المُؤْتَمَرِ⁩ , ⁧المَشْرُوعُ المُقَرَّرُ إِطْلَاقُهُ⁩ ), the relative nouns with ⁧مَا⁩ and ⁧مَنْ⁩ , the series of maṣdar co-ordinates and phrases with the predicate ( ⁧وَمِنَ المُقَرَّرِ أَنْ⁩ …). In the end, you can unpack a period of paper into simple sentences and rebuild it in a natural Italian. Four weeks, in parallel with EGY-11 and EGY-12.

rows: B2 · Module B2.1 News and institutions of the European Communities
22–24 hours · four weeks (weeks 160–163), plus the EGY track in separate blocks

blocks.text: Materials This unit, pencils of three colors, Grammar reference (G28, G32, G43, G44), voice synthesis scripts, tutor sessions
Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. Read and build chains of iḍāfa of three or four terms, with the adjective in place and in the right case;
2. recognizing descriptive phrases without relative pronoun after an indeterminate name, and translating them with a relative to Italy;
3. understand the parts used as relative, including constructions ⁧المُقَرَّرُ⁩ + maṣdar + pronoun (s) expected which...
4. read the relevant nouns ( ⁧مَا قَالَهُ⁩ , ⁧مَنْ يُرِيدُ⁩ , ⁧مِمَّا⁩ ) and sentences with the predicate anticipated;
5. remove a period of 50–70 simple words and reconstruct them in English;
6. read an article by 330 words at least 80 words per minute.
Four-week plan.

Break the chain with ⁧لِـ⁩ . When ambiguity is real, the press uses ⁧لِـ⁩ : ⁧الرَّئِيسُ الجَدِيدُ لِلشَّرِكَةِ⁩ The new president of the company is hereby appointed. ⁧الاِجْتِمَاعُ السَّنَوِيُّ لِوُزَرَاءِ المِيَاهِ⁩ The annual meeting of water ministers is held. After an indeterminate name its does not ⁧الَّذِي⁩ : the phrase follows directly the name (it is called ⁧جُمْلَةُ الصِّفَةِ⁩ ). It almost always contains a pronoun that refers to the name (the return pronoun) ⁧الضَّمِيرُ العَائِدُ⁩ ), except when the name is the subject of the verb.

8. Disassemble and rebuild

Unmount (in Arabic): 1. finds the spine (B2-01); 2. loosen the chains of iḍāfa and attribute adjectives; 3. transforms every descriptive, participle-related and engraving phrase into a simple sentence. Rebuild (in English): 4. choose the natural order in English; 5. use relative, Gerundi, two points or two sentences; 6. read without looking at Arabic.

9. Pronunciation and Prosody

Read a chain of iḍāfa. Without pauses inside: it is a single long word. ⁧وَزِيرِ⁩ _ ⁧خَارِجِيَّةِ⁩ _ ⁧الدَّوْلَةِ⁩ . The pause comes after the last term or after the adjective that follows it. Read a descriptive sentence. No pause between the name and the phrase describing it: ⁧مَشْرُوعًا⁩ _ ⁧يَهْدِفُ إِلَى⁩ …; a short break instead before ⁧وَالَّذِي⁩ where its co-ordinates to another information. The tanwīn before the descriptive sentence. It is pronounced: ⁧مَشْرُوعًا يَهْدِفُ⁩ ( mašrūʿan yahdifu), ⁧خُطَّةٌ لَمْ تَرَ⁩ ( ḫuṭṭatun lam tara). It is a sound clue: the name is indeterminate, so what follows describes it.
